# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_RIBBON_FADE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price opens above the opening range high and VWAP but the EMA ribbon (8/21/55) is bearishly aligned, mean-reversion back into the opening range offers a long edge. This fade setup exploits temporary overextension against the intraday trend structure, with the bearish ribbon acting as a filter for high-probability mean-reversion spots.

## Mechanism

At 09:45 ET, check if: price > OR_high AND price > VWAP AND EMA8 < EMA21 < EMA55 for two consecutive 5-minute bars. If true, enter long on the first subsequent 5-minute bar that closes <= OR_high with volume > 1.2 * average 5-minute volume of the prior 20 bars. Exit: chart-stop at OR_low (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1.5R risk-reward, runner trailed 10% below highest-water-mark. Trade window: 09:45-11:30 ET, avoid 10:00-10:30 after major economic releases, only when VIX < 20.
